overall_assessment: Core sections (course_content, learning_outcomes, teaching_methods) are extracted cleanly and completely for Nord, and the 'boilerplate', 'short' and most 'leak' flags are false alarms or symptoms of one real problem. The real problem is that coursework_requirements is never emitted: arbeidskrav and obligatorisk deltakelse always sit inside assessment, together with exam-logistics and COVID/AI-cheating notices.

findings.evidence: Arbeidskrav: 3 arbeider, teller 0/100 av karakteren, muntlig/skriftlig, individuelt/gruppe, karakterregel: godkjent/ikke godkjent.
findings.description: Nord plans put Arbeidskrav (AK), Obligatorisk deltakelse (OD) and Obligatorisk arbeid under a single Vurdering heading. The extractor files all of it under assessment and never emits a coursework_requirements row for any of the 28 courses. The codebook says these approve/fail gates belong in coursework_requirements, so the pre-pass leak->coursework_requirements flags are real here.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Nord has one combined 'Vurderingsordninger' block and no heading-level split. The splitter cuts only at headings, so AK/OD/OA lines cannot go anywhere else.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a nord-specific post-split step in .clean_sections() (R/extract_sections.R). Move paragraphs or lines that start with 'Arbeidskrav', 'Obligatorisk deltakelse', 'Obligatorisk deltaking', 'Obligatorisk arbeid', 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' or '(AK)/(OD)/(OA)' from assessment into coursework_requirements. Keep Mappe, Hjemmeeksamen, Skoleeksamen and Muntlig eksamen in assessment.

findings.evidence: På bakgrunn av Covid-19 epidemien blir en rekke vurderinger og eksamener ved Nord universitet endret.
findings.description: Assessment is polluted by time-limited administrative notices: COVID-19 temporary assessment-change regulations (with legal citations and repeated 'from/to' blocks) and the standard ChatGPT/AI-cheating notice. Exam aids ('Penn, linjal og inntil 2 stk tospråklige ordbøker', 'Kalkulator.') and exam-place lines also appear. This is exam logistics or admin text, not the assessment form, and in MUS2003 it duplicates the Praktisk eksamen and Hjemmeeksamen lines.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Everything under the Vurdering heading is passed through, and .clean_sections() has no Nord boilerplate patterns.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() or a Nord handler, drop paragraphs that match 'Covid-19', 'Midlertidig forskrift', 'koronaepidemien', 'Å generere besvarelse ved hjelp av', 'Eksamenssted følger', or that are bare aids lines ('^Kalkulator', '^Penn, linjal').

findings.evidence: Opptak skjer på bakgrunn av generell studiekompetanse eller realkompetanse etter gjeldende regler.
findings.description: Prerequisites hold admission, programme-restriction or availability text rather than actual prior knowledge. Examples: 'Kan tas som frittstående fag i lærerutdanning.', the general admission sentence above, and 'Emnet er forbeholdt studenter ved master grunnskolelærerutdanning 1-7.'. The codebook treats admission boilerplate as not a prerequisite. Real prerequisites such as 'Forkunnskapskrav: Bestått 90 stp. i masterfaget.' and 'Gjennomført Naturfag 1A og Naturfag 1B eller tilsvarende.' are correct.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Nord 'Forkunnskaper/Opptak' block is mapped wholesale to prerequisites; no content filter is applied to admission and availability sentences.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter prerequisites lines matching 'generell studiekompetanse', 'Kan tas som frittstående', 'forbeholdt', 'Opptak til studieprogrammet', 'Tilbys ikke som enkeltstående' and 'Valgbart'. Emit no row if nothing remains.

findings.description: A prerequisites row is emitted whose whole content is the placeholder '...'. Prerequisites 'Ingen utover opptakskravet.' in the PEL1001 courses is a similar near-empty statement.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The placeholder filter in .clean_sections() does not cover '...' or 'Ingen utover opptakskravet'.
findings.suggested_fix: Treat text that is only dots, dashes, 'Ingen', 'Ingen.' or 'Ingen utover opptakskravet.' as empty and drop the row.

findings.evidence:
Munnleg eksamen (MU): Individuell munnleg eksamen. Eksamen blir vurdert med gradert karakter A-F. Den munnlege eksamen tel 60 % av samla karakter i emnet.

Læreplanen i KRLE for grunnskulen
findings.description: Short trailing fields from neighbouring plan fields are appended to the end of assessment. In REL1005 the line 'Læreplanen i KRLE for grunnskulen' is a reading-list or reference item. In the KHV courses a stray 'Ingen' (a following field, probably 'Pensum' or 'Andre krav') ends the assessment, and a 'VURDERINGSORDNING' label is left inline. No reading_list row is produced for any of the 28 courses.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Fields after the Vurdering block (reading-list or other-requirements headings that are unmapped or absent) are folded into the preceding section.
findings.suggested_fix: Map Nord's pensum/litteratur and 'Andre krav' headings to reading_list or an explicit drop in R/section_heading_map.R. Strip a trailing line that is only 'Ingen' and strip inline 'VURDERINGSORDNING' labels.
